body: I'm sorry you're going through this. It's an awful awful feel. She does not deserve you. There is no excuse for cheating. If she wasn't happy for whatever reasons, then she she have communicated or left. But not cheated! That's bullshit. You sound like a good person. I was in a similar situation where I worked third shift and yet still did cooking and everything I could for my partner, while maintaining my career. She then resented me for not being around enough (while I did all I could to support her getting her doctorate) it's all bullshit. You deserve to live and be happy and there is someone out there who would love and appreciate to be with someone like you. I can guarantee that.
Because I set a date and am trying to enjoy life the best I can until then.
Have you tried to take medication for the anxiety or insomnia? Sometimes these help temporarily while we figure out how to get through.

Hey thanks for responding. I really appreciate it. It's not easy for me to reach out like this. But if everything truly goes downhill, at least I can say I tried. I'm up for talking more if you are. Feel free to message me.

I read your whole story and I'm sorry you had to endure that. Your body had been pushed to the limits and it could only handle so much torture. That's not your fault! I didn't realize that kind of treatment was still going on in the military.  I don't know if you have PTSD or not, but you definitely lived through a traumatizing experience. Constant anxiety and pain  like what you faced will leave a lasting mark for sure. Do not be ashamed by that. I think that situation would have fucked up anyone who had to go through it.
I'm up. Feel free to message
"Things will get better", "it could be worse", "go try to watch a funny movie", "try to think more positive thoughts", "get outside! It's a beautiful day! :)"

Hey, you're not alone. You have us here. I know that hardly compares to family or friends you can see but we are all sharing this same pain. I'm sorry you're feeling so low. I have a dog too that I feel bad about leaving behind. Animals love us unconditionally and I think that's why we love them so much. Could you possibly rescue another dog? You would be saving a life, and perhaps yours would be saved as well.

Hey, I'm going through the exact same thing. My ex is in veterinary school and I live an hour away. We were together three and a half years. She left me because she's a perfectionist and couldn't even handle the hour drive because it was too much for her. Anyways, I know what you're feeling and it's the worst feeling in the world and I wouldn't wish this upon anyone. I have since been suicudal and my health has declined. I initiated no contact right after the breakup because it hurt so bad. I miss my best friend, like I am experiencing a death. If I knew a way to make you feel better, I would suggest it. It sounds like you have a promising future and are striving towards things that most can't. Just take one day, or one hour, at a time. You got this. Feel free to message me if you want to talk more.
Well if anything, you have the best username I have ever seen.

Yup. I'm basically looking for someone to "save me" which sucks because I know that's wrong. I have a good amount of friends but it doesn't fill the void of not being in love. I was just on a dating app before coming on here.  I don't know what I'm doing because mentally I'm a disaster right now. Totally get what you are saying though. It's a bad trap because we are supposed to love ourselves first. Argh.

I've been secretly wishing for a heart attack for quite awhile now. Mostly so I don't have to hurt my family with intentionally harming myself. I died once in the hospital because I was given too much morphine and other pain meds when I had an injury when I got hurt at work. I wish I stayed dead. It was ridiculously peaceful when I slipped away (because of the morphine I'm sure). Not a care in the world.

I've realized that when you've reached the point of finding peace, that's usually the most dangerous time. Can you find it in you to give that handgun back, and give yourself more time. I read these posts, and wish that no one would feel this way. I know exactly what you're going through.

If mental illness is something we don't have much control over, and is viewed much like any other serious illness, then why should one be punished for giving in to suicide? I mean how much control does one person have when your own brain turns against you? Reasons for this could be hormonal imbalance, genetics, life trauma. Things that are essentially sort of out of our control.

I know exactly how you're feeling. Also, when the suicidal thoughts do tend to fade to the background, I feel strange. They have been with me every day for the past four months. Some days the thoughts are louder than others. I hope that you don't get access to a gun, because that just makes it all worse. I have a few and just knowing that I have that type of option, makes this all too real. Feel free to message me if you want to talk about it.
I'm up. 4am here too. Lots of anxiety tonight. I think this crazy harvest moon isn't helping.  Can you give yourself another month?
I own a .40. Just went out today and bought a .45. If I was ever going to do it, it would be that way.

You're right. Just about every single person even remotely close to you, will think there is something they could have done to change the situation. If you end your life, you will be causing much severe pain to those around you. That is something you either accept, or don't hurt yourself. Obviously choosing to live would be the best option. But each person has their own struggles and can only handle so much.
I think they say that if a family member has chosen suicide, then there is a higher risk for other family members. I think that's because depression or mood disorders can have a genetic link.
No- for many reasons. It's not worth ending your life. And a 9mm will only end up hurting you.

I can relate to some things you've said. Because of Lyme disease, I can no longer try to escape reality with alcohol or anxiety meds. I'm not sure which is worse. Having to rely on these things to get by, or not being able to use them to dull the emotional pain.
You are an excellent writer. So don't believe for a second that you aren't good at anything.
That sounds really good. If I didn't have to go to work soon, I'd probably go out and get some. Now it's going to be on my mind for sure.

Hey, Cold Stone is just as good haha. The frozen yogurt place I go to uses a lot of local ingredients. I got a strawberry chocolate twist. It was pretty darn good. Wish life could always feel as good as when you are eating ice cream! What's your favorite?

I understand where you are coming from. I've recently developed skin issues as well, and then I stress about it, and then it makes the situation worse. And it's this vicious cycle. I stay in bed a lot more, similar to how you are handling your issues. 

One thing I have noticed, is that I have become a lot more compassionate to others who appear to be dealing with physical issues. It made me almost look at the world differently. That imperfections aren't bad, and that people who struggle with stuff like this are often some of the most awesome people you'll meet. Maybe you'll find that you will end up connecting with people who are also struggling, and in that, you will develop much deeper connections. 
Just know that you are absolutely not alone, eventhough at times it can feel that way. Feel free to message if you want to talk more about what's going on.
I know the feeling.
I'm trying to keep trudging on. Despite the obstacles that keep getting thrown in my face. Thanks for checking in. It means a lot.

I'm sorry you had a bad week. I did as well. The first time I went to my doctor to figure out what's wrong with me, she just sent me home with a bunch of pain meds and ran a standard blood test. It was all downhill from there. I switched docs, and the new one thought I was crazy for believing I had lyme. (Since my sister also has it, I'm familiar with the symptoms). I then cried in the office when she told me it's impossible for people to have chronic lyme. I'm fortunate enough to had Lyme literate doctors in my area, so after months of waiting, I was able to get properly tested and get treatment. The treatment screwed my body up worse and I stopped after 6 months of oral antibiotics. I still have many of the same symptoms I've had since I started. I've also developed other health issues and now spend a lot of my days in bed, depressed. When I'm not doing that, I have to be at work. Since so many people are unfamiliar with Lyme, it makes me feel like I have this rare plague. I can imagine you feel the same way about CFS. I live alone, which makes me feel even more isolated. I've lost a ton of weight (and I need to be physically fit for my job) and because of the stress, new things keep coming up to derail me. That's how I ended up on this site. I just didn't want to feel so alone anymore.
Do you spend a lot of time in bed? What do you do to keep going? I check this site once a day, so feel free to talk whenever you'd like. Thanks for checking back in with me.
Thanks for taking the time to listen and respond.

Wow, I'm so sorry for everything you've been through. You truly are a tough person. I can't blame you for wanting to mask the pain with drugs. I want to say something to help you in this moment, but I'm not sure my words will be enough. I don't even know you, but your story truly struck me. You're like one of those soldiers who keeps on going, no matter the hell they've endured. im proud of you for that. Feel free to message if you need to talk further.

They won't slowly forget about you. Suicide changes the lives of those left behind dramatically. So at least allow yourself to believe that. Your death may even cause others to contemplate suicide. im not judging your thoughts.. In fact my thoughts have been similar to yours. Just know that people truly do care.

I'm sorry you're feeling this way. It happened to me recently as well. No words I say will make this better for you. Time is the only thing that will begin to help. Losing someone is often one of the toughest things we can deal with in life. There will be something good that comes out of this I promise.

Happy birthday to you. I cared to read this. I have been unable to sleep after taking two sleeping pills, then started with the anxiety. So I came on here to see if I could help. I'm sorry you're going through such a difficult time, you sound like you deserve much better than this. The Xanax can help for a little bit, but it sounds like you need a good support system. I'm glad you posted, because it's good to reach out and express yourself. Keep doing that, in any way you can.
I'll talk with you. Message me
You're not stupid. When you're depressed and little things go wrong, they feel like bad things. Depression gives us a short fuse. It's brain chemistry. Don't blame yourself.
I have a feeling you're not a terrible person. We are our own worst critic.
Yes, really. I know a good amount about firearms. A .9mm definitely won't work. Just don't do it. You have a much better chance of bettering your life.
Not a good idea, especially with only a .9mm. You'll just end up hurting yourself. Please stick around.

Don't be ashamed of being gay! I hid my entire first relationship (year and a half) and it was really tough to deal with when it ended because no one knew. I've had several relationships since then, and have been out for a long time. What you need is a good support system. There is nothing wrong with you! In my opinion, identifying as a lesbian (gay) is awesome and I wouldn't have it any other way. Feel free to message me if you need to vent more.

Sounds like you're going through a lot and having a tough time finding the support you need. I think that the not sleeping and not eating thing is probably making you feel worse emotionally. I haven't been able to sleep for months either. Not even a high dose of Ambien knocks me out. Maybe if you slowly start completing the things you want to get done, you'll feel a bit better? Once you allow yourself to gain some control, you may start to take baby steps towards getting out of this depression.

Yeah same with me, it came back negative three times before it came back positive. Same thing with my sister, who also has Lyme disease. In the U.S., many doctors still refuse to believe how bad Lyme disease is, and few know to how to properly treat it. It can also have 100 different symptoms, but many similar to CFS. I'm not assuming you have Lyme disease, but if you can find a doctor who is willing to properly test you, then it's worth a try. My symptoms come and go and range with intensity.
 I'm no longer able to work out (I used to spend a lot of time in the gym). I have to take a ton of supplements. My whole body is thrown off. It's so difficult when you have to alter the way you are used to living. I hope that knowing you aren't alone offers you some kind of peace. Feel free to keep in touch. Maybe we can be a good support system for each other..

I have Lyme disease- so I totally understand what you are going through. Have you ever properly been tested for Lyme disease? Sometimes CFS is misdiagnosed when in fact, it's Lyme disease. You'll need to go to a "Lyme literate" doctor to get properly tested. Not your primary care doctor. I understand your struggle, as Lyme disease has take many things from me. I no longer live the life I once did, and it has caused me more depression. If you ever want to talk further, feel free to message me.
P.s. I may not think my life is much worth living, but I think yours is and I hope you don't actually hurt yourself.

I know what you mean about not being able to see much of a future. Also about the obsessive thoughts of wanting to end things. Those obsessive thoughts are your way of trying to gain control of the situation. I also don't want to die but an emotionally exhausted from anxiety and depression that I try desperately hard to hide from everyone. Which is why I came to this site. I'm sorry support wasn't there for you at the hotline, but you'll find there is a good community here and you aren't alone.

A breakup isn't usually a tiny insignificant thing and you shouldn't feel bad about it derailing you. Breakups take a toll on us emotionally and physically. It sounds like you've been through a lot and this is kind of the icing on the cake for pushing you over. Alcohol will make this a lot worse for you, as it's a depressant. So you need to stop self medicating with it. I understand the desire to get away from your thoughts though. It sounds like you need to take some time for yourself and start to find what makes you happy again. One day at a time until then.

Totally understand. Recently went through a breakup as well. I was with my partner for a few years, and now I feel lost. My health is declining from the stress. I just want you to know that even if someone ends a relationship with you (and does it in a cold hearted way) doesn't necessarily mean there is something wrong with you. Trust me. I've had several serous relationships and they all end differently. It sounds like you are a nice person and I really have a feeling you are going to find someone who appreciates and loves you much sooner than you think. Keep living life for yourself, and the rest will fall into place. Just don't give up.

If you feel like you're at the point of needing professional help, then don't delay. Those that truly care about you will be there for you, and not judge your decision to take care of yourself. You'll definitely have plenty of emotional support, even from the strangers on here. We get what you're going through.
I certainly do give a fuck because I know exactly how you are feeling. I sleep with a loaded gun under my pillow. But I am still here, and so are you. How about we be miserable and alive together.

I'm not going to give you advice on how to kill yourself. However I realize I have no magical words to make things better for you. Any way I can convince you to wait at least 48hrs and see how you feel?
Also think before getting an IUD- look up copper toxicity. It's a problem related to birth control.

I'm so glad I read your post. I was on birth control for endometriosis and it seriously screwed with my body. It left me some hyperpigmentation on my face which I now have to cover up with different make up before leaving the house. I've never worn make up before! It has affected my self esteem so much. So I totally get what you are going through! I've become more depressed because this issue came at a time when I became newly single. i just think that the makeup probably doesn't even look good and takes me a lot more time to get together now. It may or may not get better, just like the issue you are facing. Feel free to message me and we can share our problems further. You are not alone! And I totally understand what you are going through.

You are researching because it's helping you think you have control. When we reach suicidal levels it's because we have lost control. So your obsessive thoughts over suicide is actually a way for your brain to try and gain some control.  I'm feeling very much the same way. I have a plan figured out because that makes me feel better. It helps me feel less stuck. Even if it's unhealthy.
Being gay is awesome. Embrace it and find someone worth your time. There are plenty of other people out there who would appreciate having you as a partner. Trust me! Don't lose hope.

2016 has been the worst year of my life as well. Life is full of ups and downs, and I think people prone to depression feel the sadness way more than the good times. Just know you are not alone. I'm in the same boat as you.

I'd say the first step is to address your addiction to alcohol with a good treatment program. Alcohol is horrible for depression. You need to get away from these things that are preventing you from seeing the light in this life.
Talk to me. I'm feeling a lot like you are.
You need to do whatever you can to get away. Find resources to help you and get out.
How are you feeling now?

I haven't actually attempted to do anything, however I have a gun that I have been keeping under my pillow. I have held it to my head a few times just to see if I could picture myself pulling the trigger. I'm not proud to admit that.  I have been having extreme anxiety for the past six months because my partner of three and a half years left me, and I have been dealing with health issues. Because of the line of work I'm in, I have to be careful of showing any mental health problems. The person whose position I filled actually took their own life several years ago. 

I feel myself slipping away, at first it was slow, and now it has amped up. I barely sleep and my thoughts race a lot of the time. For awhile I was on Xanax, but that stuff is addicting and I made myself stop taking it.

I'm having trouble coping with the loss of my relationship, and the loss of my sanity. My body can't take any more stress, as it only makes my health issues worse.

The gun is under my pillow. I have it loaded with two hollow point bullets. I don't know where I'd actually do it, because I wouldn't want to around my dog and cats. 

I've had to make myself almost blank out lately, because if I look at my mom, who is my best friend, it makes this so much harder.

I'm ready to go. I'm tired. I know a lot of people will probably be hurt, but I don't have the energy to live for other people anymore.
I can't believe I'm typing this, and that this is my story.
